title: Eben Alexander near-death experience

tellings.quote: He has a very interesting scientific outlook of his near-death. And that was like this, like overarching, like, loving energy.

plain: David Grusch, a former US intelligence officer turned whistleblower about UFOs, told Jesse Michels in 2023 about Eben Alexander, who wrote a book called Proof of Heaven about his near-death experience in 2008. Grusch says Alexander has a very scientific way of looking at it and describes what he met as an overarching, loving energy. Grusch raises it because, if true, consciousness might carry on beyond the body.
